from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-676f8cb8.py'
code='''def transform(grid):\n    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0]\n    # The seed diagonal identifies the repeating diagonal color; the other\n    # marked color fills the remaining two residue classes.\n    seed = next(v for v in colors if v not in (0,))\n    phase = next((c-r) % 3 for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == seed)\n    other = next(v for v in colors if v != seed)\n    return [[seed if (c-r) % 3 == phase else other for c in range(m)] for r in range(n)]\n'''
path.write_text(code)
# demo pair data as rows from the supplied demonstration; compactly generate and verify expected pattern
spec=__import__('importlib.util').util.spec_from_file_location('task',path)
mod=__import__('importlib.util').util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Demo's first-color seed 1 on phase 0; other color 8.
demo_in=[[0]*19 for _ in range(19)]
for r in range(7): demo_in[r][12+r]=1
for r in range(13,19): demo_in[r][r-13]=8
for r in (17,18):
    for c in (r-13+4,):
        demo_in[r][c]=8
# build output as listed pattern formula
expected=[[1 if (c-r)%3==0 else 8 for c in range(19)] for r in range(19)]
print('demo matches formula', mod.transform(demo_in)==expected)
